dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Hi! Are you Nam? I'm Kate. Welcome to our department!
dialogue.reading: ˈhaɪ! ər juː ˈnɑːm? aɪm ˈkeɪt. ˈwɛlkəm tə aʊər dɪˈpɑːrtmənt!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Thank you! It's my first day. This is my first internship.
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋk juː! ɪts maɪ ˈfɜːrst ˈdeɪ. ðɪs ɪz maɪ ˈfɜːrst ˈɪntɜːrnʃɪp.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Great. Has Mr. Davis given you a task yet?
dialogue.reading: ˈɡreɪt. hæz ˈmɪstər ˈdeɪvɪs ˈɡɪvən juː ə ˈtæsk ˈjɛt?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes. He wants me to write an email to our head office in Singapore.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. hiː ˈwɑːnts miː tə ˈraɪt ən ˈiːmeɪl tə aʊər ˈhɛd ˈɔːfɪs ɪn ˈsɪŋəpɔːr.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: That's easy. Does he want you to do anything else?
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈiːzi. dʌz hiː ˈwɑːnt juː tə ˈduː ˈɛniθɪŋ ˈɛls?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes. He told me to call some hotels in Phuket, too.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. hiː ˈtoʊld miː tə ˈkɔːl sʌm hoʊˈtɛlz ɪn puːˈkɛt, ˈtuː.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: OK. I can help you with that.
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ. aɪ kən ˈhɛlp juː wɪð ðæt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Thanks! Are there many people in our department?
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋks! ər ðɛr ˈmɛni ˈpiːpəl ɪn aʊər dɪˈpɑːrtmənt?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Six. Your colleagues are all very nice. And Mr. Davis wants us all to have lunch together today.
dialogue.reading: ˈsɪks. jʊr ˈkɑːliːɡz ər ˈɔːl ˈvɛri ˈnaɪs. ənd ˈmɪstər ˈdeɪvɪs ˈwɑːnts ʌs ˈɔːl tə ˈhæv ˈlʌntʃ təˈɡɛðər təˈdeɪ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Great! I'd like to meet everyone.
dialogue.reading: ˈɡreɪt! aɪd ˈlaɪk tə ˈmiːt ˈɛvriwʌn.
